reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing linkExternalAccount/linkBankAccount helper and the balance path reuses the akahu branch, but the transaction download is a fresh copy rather than a shared function.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near line-for-line copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (token check, post, error mapping, response shaping), differing only in the server URL and log text.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the tree puts it: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in sync.ts, base URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Only the server-side additions the request asks for; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Follows the established per-provider pattern and is easy to own, though one more copied download function adds to the existing duplication across providers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: linkFintegraAccount delegates to linkExternalAccount; nothing goes around an existing abstraction (there is no shared download helper to bypass)

disguised_duplication.where: the copied download function is an open copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, not disguised
